units.source_text: 这大概是驹子在东京生活留下来的痕迹吧。

en.t: This was probably a trace left over from Komako's life in Tokyo.

units.source_text: 那别致的直木纹衣柜和名贵的朱漆针线盒，依然摆在这冷清清的二楼上，就如同住在师傅家那间旧纸盒似的顶楼时一样，显得格外凄怆。

en.t: The elegant straight-grained wardrobe and the costly vermilion-lacquer sewing box still stood on this cold, empty second floor, just as they had when she lived in the paper-box-like attic at her teacher's house, and they looked all the more forlorn.
